acceptance: SlickGrid and Django admin join development and FullCalendar joins validation, pinned, licensed, run on disposable state, captured reproducibly, annotated by separate sessions and measured; held-out untouched and no family shared across partitions.

positive.fixture: 17 new page states (Django admin 9, SlickGrid 4, FullCalendar 4); 81 of 81 captures reproduce their recorded digest; 58 development and validation states measured on the pre-B11 and T02 recognizers

negative.fixture: package requirement without a hash or without an exact version, family split across partitions, unpinned revision, missing license and ground truth are refused

regression.command: cd tests/observation && npx playwright test specs/element.spec.ts

versions.schema: manifest gains the pip fetch kind; observer Session gains elementOf; no wire change

security_and_source_permissions: Django admin runs on loopback with a disposable SQLite database and a test account created by the harness; nothing leaves the machine; hashes pin every package.
performance_memory_storage: Capture 0.7 to 3.6 s per state; fixtures/corpus grows by about 0.2 MB of dossiers and annotations.
known_limitations: Annotators are model sessions; the Django annotator consulted no documentation and said so in its basis
The corpus has fifteen applications, above the guideline of eight to twelve, because each addition closes a named gap
A host project of three models defines the Django admin content; the interface itself is Django's
